components.name: CompositeFiltersComponent
components.description:
Composite filters component renders different filters based on the type of
the corresponding filterable property, e.g., string, enum, number, etc.

outputs.name: propertyFiltersChange
outputs.description: Event emitter to tell hosting view that the filtering conditions have changed

components.name: DataGridFiltersComponent
components.description:
Component provides the ability to choose from quick filter (search)
and advanced filter (composite filters).

inputs.name: filterMode
inputs.description: Quick, Advanced or AdvancedOnly. Default Quick.

outputs.name: searchTermChange
outputs.description:
Event emitter to tell hosting view that search term, used for filtering
has changed.

outputs.name: apply
outputs.description: Event emitter to tell hosting view that apply button was clicked

outputs.name: cancel
outputs.description: Event emitter to tell hosting view that cancel button was clicked
